primary_strategy.name: PUBLIC_PINNED_PACKAGES_SOURCES_AND_SCOPED_RUNTIME_DELTA
primary_strategy.timing: After exact native closure/empty owned job/original writer-lock release, and at final toolchain freeze after scientific work before host wipe
steps: Publish exact two original package manifest bytes and a public provenance/index manifest; retain339 distinct original package SHAs/URLs/licenses.

After cold authority and public-scope review, preserve exact original source/model archives, native distribution, used pip/R/non-conda artifacts and actual installed-binary/model per-file SHA manifest. Retain all original copyright/license/source notices and explicit local modification/source bindings.
For package artifacts absent locally, fetch only the pinned official URLs into a new namespace and verify original SHA/size. Package restoration alone does not prove identical installed-tree bytes.

Hash and archive scoped used project caches/runtime deltas not already byte-covered remotely; deduplicate immutable package/content identity, preserve POSIX modes/symlink targets/hardlinks and exact required install prefix. Do not archive outside reviewed project scopes.

Stream a deterministic public archive with bounded buffers, one compression worker and fixed448MiB compressed chunks (469762048B, strictly below500MiB); each chunk has SHA/size, ordered whole-stream SHA, exhaustive entry SHA/metadata manifest and sidecar. No8GiB in-memory materialization.

Publish source/restore code/index/licenses before immutable Release assets; independently freshly download every chunk, verify GitHub ID/digest, whole stream and every entry. Restore to fresh disposable reviewed prefix and verify actual executable/model/runtime identities before declaring exact environment recovery.
primary_strategy.limits: Complete installed-runtime/pip/R/model/cache scope is deferred; no claim that package versions alone recover exact modified/runtime bytes.

guards: No blind Ubuntu root export; the scope is only the exact project toolchain loop image.

After cold ownership proof, mount the image read-only without journal replay and enumerate/review every included file, symlink, package record and cache; exclude credentials/private/unrelated data from public logical archives.

Filesystem member review alone does not prove deleted/free-block bytes contain no private remnants. Do not publicly upload raw original image unless public byte scope is independently established. Prefer a fresh clean derived image populated only with the reviewed public logical tree when a mountable environment artifact is required.
A clean derived image preserves reviewed environment file hashes/metadata, not the original image block SHA. Record that distinction.

If original image byte preservation is justified and public, freeze/unmount it first, retain exact birth/size/whole-image SHA and stream deterministic compression into448MiB chunks with independent remote download/concatenation/whole-image SHA/restore verification.
